concepts.name: Oxides
concepts.simple_definition: Oxides are binary compounds formed by the reaction of oxygen with another element.
concepts.deep_explanation: Oxides are classified as acidic (non-metal oxides like CO2), basic (metal oxides like CaO), amphoteric (Al2O3), or neutral (CO).
concepts.real_example: Calcium oxide (CaO) reacts with water to form a basic solution of calcium hydroxide.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking amphoteric oxides only behave as acids. They react with both acids and bases.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ኦክሳይዶች ማለት ኦክስጅን ከሌላ ንጥረ ነገር ጋር በመዋሃድ የሚፈጥረው ባለሁለትዮሽ ውህድ ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: ኦክሳይዶች በአሲዳማ (የአโลሃ ኦክሳይድ)፣ ቤዛዊ (የሎሃ ኦክሳይድ)፣ አምፎቴሪክ ወይም ገለልተኛ ተብለው ይከፈላሉ።
concepts.real_example_amharic: ካልሲየም ኦክሳይድ (CaO) ከውሃ ጋር ሲዋሃድ ካልሲየም ሃይድሮክሳይድ የተባለ ቤዛዊ ውህድ ይሰጣል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: አምፎቴሪክ ኦክሳይዶች አሲድ ብቻ ይመስላሉ። እነሱ ከአሲድም ከቤዝም ጋር ግብረመልስ ያደርጋሉ።
